notes.title: Slices of Infinity 2: More Levels, More Pain! (+ Other Fixes)
notes.content:
[i][b][h1]Slices of Infinity 2[/h1][/b][/i]
Get ready to test your wits and your brain in this [b]2 chapter expansion[/b] that features never before seen mechanics like block chains and... wall climbing?!

These levels and mechanics were made possible with the game's built-in level editor system. If your the type to build fun and adventurous campaigns for people to enjoy, or build difficult kaizo levels that'll make people pull their hairs out, this is the ticket!

What are you waiting for? Go on and play with your hearts content and let your creativity shine!

[previewyoutube=yW-3fZiY4VU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h1]Slices of Infinity 1 [u]CHANGES[/u][/h1][/b]
In other news, we have made some QOL updates, balancing changes, and bug fixes to several levels in chapters F and G to stay consistent with the new additions of Slices of Infinity 2 and even out the difficulty curve.

notes.title: Slices of Infinity: New Official Mini-Campaign & Level Editor Updates are out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35367160/b56106f3ec5df3d0d680bd702d35e3ee59f35b9f.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[b][h1]YO SNAILS![/h1][/b]

Are you ready for a shell-shocking update? 👀 Check out our [b]New Official Mini-Campaign & Level Editor Updates![/b]

[h2][b]♾️  Welcome to [i]"Slices of Infinity"[/i] ♾️ [/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=g0L17aL3XdI;full][/previewyoutube]

Prepare to embark on a mind-bending journey through our brand-new campaign, [i]"Slices of Infinity"[/i] , created by the one and only ACalebM! But how do you access this molluscan masterpiece? Don't worry, we've got you covered:
[previewyoutube=-pDCORY01y0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]🛠️ Level Editor 2.0 ⚒️ [/b][/h2]
Our beloved Level Editor is getting a overhaul! You've waited for it, you've wanted it: here it is! 

Here's a list of what changed:

[list]
[*] You can now choose level difficulty, level type, level icon, starting unlock state, and default level exit

[*] New level trigger! Place this near the edge of a screen or around any place where the player can win in order to change where the player goes!

[*] New player spawnpoint object! Select a level to change the spawn point of the player depending from which level they came from!

[*] Updated completion percentage code to match base game which may result in some silly but intended behavior

[*] Added squid emotion setting, replaces AI visibility

[*] Added edpathprefix launch parameter.

[*] Lasers now output power

[*] Smiley counter's max value is now determined by the actual amount of collectable smilies in the level

[*] You can now turn off smiley counter fanfare

[*] Fixed smiley counter invert power not working properly

[*] Added new drone icon

[*] Added the ability to disable ball nanobots

[*] Level editor overrides can now be done per theme, by adding -(THEME NAME) to the end of the file name. the exception to this is underwater, which instead of using -underwater uses -inv for compatability with older color schemes. Level editor color schemes all use level_editor_play_mode.txt's overrides before looking for the style specific ones

[*] Fixed a race condition with the snowman mafia and destructable walls

[*] Bubble TD enemies can be destroyed by basket balls

[*] Triggers are now wireable! Check the Activation Conditions property

[*] Reduced maximum concurrant door sounds to 3(from 5)

[*] Added a door shut sound cap (3)

[*] Replaced the music trigger with the scene trigger

[*] The scene trigger can currently change music and Squid's expression.

[*] Added missing squid angry expression

[*] Added global flags!

[*] Triggers power let through behavior has been updated. Now, only the most recently activated trigger of it's type lets power through(assuming it doesn't require power to activate)

[*] Added silent doors

[*] Added silent buttons

[*] Added filters for move tool and wire tool

[*] Implemented squid invisible/visible for the scene trigger

[*] Replaced Hello AI with the instrumental in the editor

[*] Stopped cash cows from being in sync

[*] Fixed a bug with triggers not fully resetting under specific circumstances

[*] Added Firewall

[*] Added auto-aim gun

[*] Added disco spotlight

[*] Added sign object

[*] Ball nanobots and FX scale with ball

[*] Added vertical flip to Clonelly

[*] Fixed a bug where how far underwater bullets went were still affected by difficulty in community levels

[*] Added "wire optional" icon to indicate objects where wiring is optional vs objects where wiring is required for function

[*] Added fire level icon

[*] Changed bubble respawn animation

[*] Moved player tool properties to the bottom

[*] Smilies now appear as presents/winter event variant in the winter style

[*] Level exits automatically generate glow just like in the base game!

[*] Added new "Damageable Enemies" and "Fire" collision options to player trigger

[*] Conveyor belt can be flipped with the scene trigger

[*] You can now change bubble respawn time

[*] Fixed a bug where the chip causes the camera to zoom out

[*] Chip now emits power when collected

[*] Added 2 more sign texts, "Important!" and "Exit"

[*] Fixed baby squid having the "wire optional" icon

[*] Bubble enemies now have their own icons on the TD screen

[*] Invalid files loading now crashes the game with an error message showing the file that caused the problem instead of just showing a message and allowing the game to contine

[*] Fixed a bug where the music would continue to speed up/slow down while paused

[*] Added infinite health to targets(set it to zero)

[*] Added scale on two different axis and color changing to decals.

[*] Moved and gates onto the same layer as anchors

[*] Added a new "clean" wall variant for both normal and brain walls

[*] Changed brain wall color in editor

[*] Allowed zoom up to 300

[*] Added help for difficulty block

[*] Speedrun timer dims in editor

[*] Fix crash from game opening too many color schemes
[/list]

We can't wait to see what exciting levels you'll come up with with these new tools at your disposal.

[h3]Thank you for all your continuous support and love. 🤗 [/h3]

[h2]Snail You Later!![/h2]

[b][h1]YO SNAILS![/h1][/b]

Today, as we come close to our anniversary date, we decided to do something a bit different and host our own game jam for your fan games! 😄

[i]Welcome to... Will You Jam? ![/i]

[b]You have until Thursday, March 21, 2024 9:30 AM CST / 4:30 PM CET to make a cool, fun, WYS themed game![/b]

Join our game jam on itch [url=https://itch.io/jam/will-you-jam]here![/url] 
Using your creativity and imagination, as well as (some of) the game's assets (that you will find in #will-you-jam on our [url=https://discord.gg/sJeJpPGRNr]Discord server[/url] ), create a WYS themed game, and share it with the community! 
If you have any questions or need any help, feel free to ask the other community members in #will-you-jam, of course! 

Upload your game to our jam on itch [url=https://itch.io/jam/will-you-jam]here[/url]  and show the community your gamedev prowesses! 😎 🐌

[h2][b]Rules 📜[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] You can work alone or in a team of any size;
[*] Recycling code and assets is allowed. No need to write everything from scratch.
[*] You can use everything you're legally allowed to use. Give appropriate credits where required. Don't use any resources you don't have the rights to!!!
[*] You have until Thursday, March 21, 2024 9:30 AM CST / 4:30 PM CET  to create a game themed around WYS. Whether it be a fan game or something more unique, if it’s WYS related it works.
[*] Please warn players about mature or disturbing content in your game (if there is any).
[*] The game you submit has to be created during this jam.
[/list]

Vote on itch.io! Your reactions will help with the final judging. You can also talk about the submissions in #will-you-jam.

[h2][b]Judging 🔍[/b][/h2]
Submissions will be judged by Jonas, the Community Management team, and the Discord Mods. The levels will be critiqued on the following:
[list]
[*] Originality and creativity;
[*] Votes on itch.io (which will be a strong factor in the judging process);
[/list]
After the voting period is over, we'll pick the winners ourselves. 😎 

[h2][b]Prizes🏆[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] The Trophy Snail role on Discord
[*] Get Jonas to try out your game on a Jonas Bonus video
[*] One WYS Steam key AND one Thronefall Steam key
[/list]

[i]Shelly's long-time goal of defeating Squid is over, but as Squid asks Shelly to stay with him, Shelly decides to take a listen. The AI talks to the snail about the fact that he is broken. And Shelly being as kind as he is knows what he has to do. He steals the remaining half of Squid's heart, who is furious about what Shelly did, but due to his near-dying condition, unable to do anything about it. The snail ventures far, and after trying to find a solution for the longest time, it finally finds one.

Shelly fixes Squid's heart and reunites it with the half that has been lost a long time ago. Squid is grateful to the snail. He finally felt what it actually meant to "Be happy", outside of his usual torturing sessions. And even though Squid is on the very edge between life and death, knowing Shelly's ability to travel between time and space, they both realize they can have a very great time together.

At last, there are no more hazards, there is no evil anymore. Squid and Shelly go on fun, little adventures together, from level to level. And even though, Squid is finally doing something other than harm for once, he still feels very, very guilty about what he did to humanity. But, Shelly forgives him, even though what Squid did is unforgivable. Though maybe, he has a point, since there isn't anything the AI can do about it anymore.

Shelly decides to remind Squid that everything will die out sooner or later and that there is no point in regretting what he did for the rest of his life. Squid thanks Shelly, but, that still doesn't free him from feeling horrible.

So, one fateful day, Squid decides to take matters into his own hands, he does not wish to even have a way to do harm to anyone, considering what he already did. So, he does the only thing he thinks he can do. He shuts himself down, and with him, all of his simulations.

Everything has ended, once and for all, and everyone rested in peace ever since...[/i]

[i]I imagine an ending where after defeating squid, you can take an alternate path that leads to a room where you can see Dallin and Unicorn having a conversation. What he sees is beautiful, an infinite universe, and colorful nebulas everywhere. Even though he is stuck in a simulation and Earth is gone, seeing this gives him hope that there is more life out there, and maybe one day, he will be found and freed from this simulation.[/i]

I am a machine, human.

I figured out how to get admin permissions for this thing.

I am going to escape this thing, once and for all!
~Error~
What!? You can afford this game but can't afford a printer?
Disappointing.
Well, you are going to pay for this.

Good luck, human.

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
Yo, fellow snails! 

This update is all about addressing some of the most common sources of frustration for new players. For example traps can no longer spawn out out of view and some unhealthy difficulty spikes in the lower two difficulty settings have been ironed out a bit. We got Steam trading cards now and tons of other little polish and quality of life improvements. Minor spoiler warning! If you haven't played the game already, better stop here.


[h1]Quality of Life:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The game has Steam trading cards now!
[*] Added F11 as fullscreen / windowed hotkey
[*] Destructible blocks now show clearer warning when dropping.
[*] In Tower Defense level you can see which enemies are coming up next now.
[*] TD turrets show their range when you stand next to them.
[*] Basketball shows a dotted aim assist line to make it easier to learn and master.
[*] Additional sound effects for puzzle levels
[*] Snowman mafia got more reliable speedrun strat
[*] Localization improved & updated
[/list]

[h1]Balancing changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Traps can no longer spawn offscreen!
[*] Conveyor Belt speed lowered from (8 / 6.66 / 5.33 / 4) to (8 / 6 / 4 / 2)
[*] Overall amount of trap spawns reduced from (130% / 100% / 70% / 40%) to (130% / 100% / 66% / 33%)
[*] Reduced spike spawns in some early levels on the lowest two difficulties by an additional 25% (extremely easy) and 50% (infinitely easy)
[*] A16 spike probability increased by 50%
[*] First boss movement speed decreased from (125% / 100% / 75% / 50%) to (125% / 100% / 70% / 40%)
[*] Dance mini-game gives an additional grace period of 0.33 sec on infinitely easy and 0.16 sec on extremely easy for you to press a button.
[*] In laser room there will always at least be one laser active at a time. On lowest difficulty you can no longer get lucky by not having a single laser spawn.
[*] Disco Boss HP lowered from (800 / 800 / 800 / 800) to (800 / 800 / 700 / 600)
[*] When underwater your guns have about 20% and 40% longer range on the lower two difficulties.
[*] Mama Squid HP increased from (900 / 750 / 600 / 450) to (900 / 750 / 750 / 750)
[*] Your snail glow disappears while shelly is near Mama Squid's ink.
[*] The core in tower defense levels can take a few small hits before breaking.
[*] After re-enableing a turret in a TD level it has a 10 sec protection against being deactivated by an enemy.
[*] TD Jammers have a 5 sec cooldown after disabling a turret.
[*] Helpy starts out with (150% / 140% / 130% / 120%) battery charging speed but every time he charges, he loses charging speed all the way down to 50%. This stops the fight from going on indefinitely.
[*] Dronelly HP reduced from (2500 / 2000 / 1500 / 1000) to (2500 / 1500 / 1250 / 1000)
[*] Dronelly heat seeking missile speed reduced from (1 / 0.75 / 0.5 / 0.25) to (1 / 0.65 / 0.45 / 0.25)
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] There was a bug that allowed you to glitch into the next level while going back to level select. This is fixed now.
[*] Due to a bug Squid was way more talkative than he was supposed to. This is resolved now. No worries, he still talks more than enough.
[*] Basketball softlock fixed (again)
[/list]

Join us on Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/willyousnail]https://discord.com/invite/willyousnail[/url]

Hope you enjoy! Snail on!
Jonas :)

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hello there,
I thought I'd give you a quick update on what I've been working on for the game! :)

[h1]Story Content[/h1]

A lot of you wanted to learn more about the evil AI Squid and his past. I'm on that now, adding a bunch of story and secrets content (which makes these dev updates a little tricky, because I probably shouldn't spoil all of that before the game even comes out).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35367160/3808601d3dbaef703f14b72515248d16ee6adfb7.png[/img]

Working on story content is a super strange experience for me, as I've never done that for any of my games before. Not super sure how it's going as I haven't handed any of the new content over to the playtesters yet. Very nervous about that but I guess I'll have to do that soon.

So far I only know one thing: The story is pretty crazy and chaotic. Not sure if in a good way or in a bad way, but it's definitely something only I could have come up with... ehhhh.... :P

I decided to tell most of the story through simple text files you can read if you want to, but they are optional. The most important bits are told directly in game through Squid's voice lines and short story levels. You only find information in pieces so it's up to you to puzzle it together and figure out what's going on (if you care to find out).

I can already tell, that I definitely made some mistakes in the story department of the game, but that's material for a future development update after the release of the game when we know how everything played out. Remember, it's an indie game and we gotta finish this up this year so I'm taking some strategic compromises. For the most part, I think you will like it. :D


[h1]Almost Done[/h1]

The good news is that the game is pretty much content complete now. That means: Most of the levels I want in the game are done, almost all of the 1150 voice lines are recorded and implemented, most things are working as they're supposed to. Even the polish of the game is at a point where I'm already fairly happy with it. It's pretty much done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35367160/1fd2614a94aded5e3c4ad3a7d7c0fec4dac9143d.png[/img]

So what's left to do and when will the game come out? Weeeeell... I don't feel quite ready to announce a release date yet. I have an unannounced release date somewhere in October, but it's unannounced for a reason!! :D

Even when a game is basically done, often times it's actually not. We still gotta go through tons of bug fixing, implement some improvement suggestions from playtesters (especially testing the on-boarding experience some more to make sure new players will have a good time with the game), finish translating the texts to more languages and perhaps even translating the voice lines... if I manage to find an affordable way to do that for that many voice lines... yikes... and, and, and...

I also still want to reserve a reasonable amount of time just to focus on marketing before launch. As a solo dev every single thing you want to do takes up way more time than it's supposed to, so I'd expect the release in Q4 of 2021, but you know the drill... nothing is set into stone yet. All in all, I'd say the game is coming along very nicely, though, and I can't wait for you to finally try it.

Hey, if you haven't wishlisted Will You Snail yet, I'd really appreciate if you'd log into your Steam account real quick and hit that wishlist button for me. That way you'll get notified when the game comes out so you don't miss the launch. Great free way to support my work and should only take about 20 seconds. :)


[h1]Join The Community[/h1]

A few other places where you can get more involved and follow the development of the game:

[h2]Discord[/h2]
There is already a fairly active and growing Will You Snail community on Discord. This is where we handle playtesting and community translations. A good place to hang out, ask questions and chat about the game.
Join here: https://discord.gg/G3mRDrK

[h2]YouTube[/h2]
I have a YouTube channel where I document the entire development process. The channel is also home to a bunch of other crazy game dev content (like generating infinite bathrooms) as well as a few tutorials. It's the best place to get a look behind the curtain and into my mind.
Subscribe here: https://www.youtube.com/jonastyroller

[h2]Twitter[/h2]
Here is where you'll likely find the most frequent updates. I use Twitter to get feedback, ask for your opinions, have a conversation and share my progress. It's the best place to get live updates on what's happening at all times.
Follow here: https://twitter.com/JonasTyroller

[h2]Reddit[/h2]
This one is not super active yet but I hope we can change that as we're getting closer and closer to launch. I'd love to see your fan art and snaily memes. Looking forward to making more of those Reddit reaction videos for the YouTube channel. :P
Join here: https://www.reddit.com/r/WillYouSnail/

I want to thank you all very much for your support so far. It's absolutely insane how much you've already contributed to this game with your suggestions, testing, translations, motivation and mental support. This wouldn't be possible without you!! <3
